messages:
Eve Nakamura: Hey folks! I'm Eve (she/her) — joined today on DevEx. Based in Porto (GMT+0). I drink a lot of iced coffee, binge short podcasts, and babysit a temperamental pothos. Would love to start a recurring remote-friendly coffee chat that's timezone-friendly. Who's up for a monthly 30-min hang? :wave: :coffee:
Sam: Welcome Eve!! :tada: Count me in. I'm US West (PST) — mornings are best for me (9am PST works).
Jo: Welcome! I'm GMT-5, lunchtime or early afternoon works for me. :raised_hands:
Alex: Hi Eve — glad you're here. I usually do async but can join a monthly live. +1 to making it timezone-friendly.
Maria: Welcome Eve! CET here — evenings (late afternoon UTC) are easiest. Also, podcast recs plz :headphones:
Eve Nakamura: Thanks all! Quick poll — react with :sunrise: if mornings (UTC/UTC+0 friendly), :coffee: for afternoons (UTC+1–4), :crescent_moon: for evenings (UTC+5+). Or reply with exact slots that work for you.
Sam: :sunrise:
Jo: :coffee:
Maria: :coffee:
Alex: :crescent_moon:
Talia: :coffee:
Talia: Welcome Eve!! Also down for a mini "show & tell" segment — bring a plant/podcast/song you love.
Eve Nakamura: Love that. For the first one let's do a 30-min: 2-min show & tell each, then casual chat. I'll seed a thread for podcast/song recs.
Eve Nakamura: Tentative time I'm proposing: Fri Apr 2, 16:00 UTC (30m) — should hit late morning US West, afternoon Europe, early evening for some APAC folks. Thoughts?
Alex: That could work for me. If we get repeat attendees from APAC we can rotate the time each month.
Sam: Works for me!
Jo: Sounds good.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Remote Coffee Chat — Eve's Welcome" • Fri Apr 2 16:00 UTC • 30 minutes • Invites sent to participants.
Sam: Got the invite, thanks :thumbsup:
Jo: See you there :)
Maria: Added to my calendar — excited for podcast recs!
Eve Nakamura: Thanks everyone for the warm welcome :blush: I'll post the show & tell thread and a tiny form for time prefs if anyone wants to update. Looking forward to meeting you all!
